ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous region occupies the central and upper-left lobe. Low-intensity pixels dominate the right lobe and form a wide, irregular border along the leading edges and the central junction (peduncle area), with a high-density mottled transition zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a shallow, obtuse V-shaped vertex approximately 140-150 degrees; the depth of the depression is roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height in this projection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel deviations). The right lobe trailing edge is relatively linear until the distal tip where topography becomes highly irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a convex parabolic curve. The right lobe follows an elongated, linear-extending vector with a slight upward concavity towards the distal terminal.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) are visible near the lower central junction and at the terminal tip of the right lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular, low-intensity geometric cluster at the right distal tip, creating a jagged, multi-pointed silhouette that breaks the continuous linear trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated low-intensity focal point (island) located within the upper-left quadrant of the primary high-intensity field on the left lobe.
